headline: Steady 2Q

highlights: Consumption growth was seen across categories, with six major retail assets witnessing double-digit growth.
Consolidated EBITDA grew 7% yoy (4% below our estimates, primarily due to renovation in the hospitality segment).
The acquisition pipeline remains strong, with the management guiding for 2-3 acquisitions in FY27 (two assets already acquired in FY27).

We maintain our revenue and EBITDA estimates and reiterate BUY on the stock with an unchanged TP of Rs190, based on the NOI capitalization methodology, using a cap rate of 7% for retail assets and 8% for commercial and hospitality assets. 2QFY27 snapshot Retail: Consumption stood at Rs39bn (+13% yoy).
valuation: Leasing renewals ⏹ Re-leased 0.5msf during the quarter, with a 25% re-leasing spread. ⏹ ~50% of the area will come up for renewal over the next 3.5 years, with an MTM opportunity of 20%. ⏹ 30% of the expiring area pertains to anchor tenants, supporting higher re-leasing spreads. ⏹ Discussions have already started, and company is planning to resize large stores and renovate multiplexes, etc.

Pipeline ⏹ Construction is progressing well for the Dombivli and Guwahati malls. ⏹ The majority of new mall additions will be through the acquisition of existing operating malls. ⏹ Densification opportunities are available in existing operational malls and are currently under evaluation.

Rent to consumption ⏹ The company is targeting rent to consumption of 13% over the next 2-3 years, supported by lease renewals (11.2% in 2QFY27; lower due to the addition of high-value category brands).
watch: November 04, 2026 | 2 Nexus Select Trust (NXST IN) India Equity Research | Result Update Earnings call highlights Consumption ⏹ 2QFY27 witnessed broad-based consumption growth across categories. ⏹ Excluding jewelry and electronics, consumption grew 10% yoy. ⏹ 3Q outlook remains positive and the management expects mid-teen consumption growth during the quarter.
